description:
Join the company that’s building the telemetry infrastructure for the AI era. At Cribl, we partner with IT and Security teams at many of the world’s biggest enterprises, including half of the Fortune 100, to bridge the gap between AI ambition and infrastructure reality. As the AI Platform for Telemetry, we give customers the choice, control, and flexibility to manage and analyze telemetry for both humans and agents, so they can build what’s next.

We’re one of the fastest‑growing private companies and a leading player in a massive, fast‑moving market. With a global workforce, we’re remote‑first and grounded in a simple idea: software is a people business. Cribl is the place where curious, collaborative people can do their best work, grow fast, and bring their full selves to the herd.

Why You'll Love This Role

Cribl Search powers high-speed investigations for security and IT teams at some of the world's largest enterprises. Whether data lives in Lakehouse Engines or is spread across Federated sources, Search unifies ingest, storage, and analysis into a single experience — no tool-hopping, no complex orchestration. Teams collect once, search anywhere, and investigate with no blind spots.

Now add agentic AI to the picture. AI-driven workloads are exploding, autonomous agents are firing queries alongside human analysts, and the volume and complexity of concurrent searches is growing fast. The query engine at the heart of Cribl Search needs to be faster, more concurrent, and more resilient than ever — and that's where you come in.

Cribl is looking for a backend-focused Staff Software Engineer to join a remote-first, diverse, inclusive, cross-functional team of software developers focused on making search stupid fast. You will play a central role in evolving the query engine at the heart of Cribl Search – breaking through concurrency ceilings, optimizing query dispatching and execution, and tuning performance for workloads ranging from interactive analyst investigations to AI agents firing thousands of concurrent queries. This is an ideal role for anyone who is passionate about making Search blazing fast at a massive scale.

On top of it all, you will have fun! Cribl strives to be a great place to work for everyone.


As An Active Member Of Our Team, You Will …

  • Contribute to technical direction, bringing strong, loosely held, opinions to shape how Cribl Search evolves as a platform for multiple products
  • Own high-impact changes to large-scale systems, increasing performance and concurrency for both human and AI-driven agentic workloads
  • ​​Build and support a strong foundation for Cribl Search as a whole, collaborating across various teams and divisions
  • Champion improvements to performance, reliability, and operability
  • Drive clarity across multiple stakeholders and ambiguous requirements, communicating tradeoffs and risks of competing priorities
  • Partner with leadership to translate organizational needs from across the business into actionable plans on our roadmap
  • Lead projects end-to-end – from ideation, scoping and design through implementation, testing, deployment, and production support
  • Mentor and coach engineers through design reviews, code reviews, and pairing
  • Write clean, maintainable, and testable code with an eye toward observability and resilience
  • Share on-call responsibilities as part of a team that embraces service ownership
  • Help define and refine the software development practices that make our team effective – everybody’s feedback helps shape our process 
  • We are a remote-first company and work happens across many time-zones – this position will require stand-by, on-call, or off-hours duties 


If You've Got - We Want It

  • Strong experience designing and operating multiple-petabyte-scale data systems, including object and distributed storage
  • Experience building search, query, and/or analytic systems working with structured and unstructured data
  • Deep understanding of how search tools work – indexing, inverted indices, query parsing, and execution (think Lucene/Solr, Elasticsearch)
  • Experience working on high-performance, data-intensive applications where concurrency, throughput, and latency matter
  • Familiarity with compilers, ASTs, and query language internals
  • Polyglot engineer – C++ experience is highly desirable
  • Ability to problem-solve from first principles and maintain focus on overarching objectives
  • Demonstrated ability to lead projects through ambiguity, driving technical decisions across team boundaries
  • Experience working in a fast paced, dynamic environment where priorities shift quickly
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written – able to explain complex technical topics to stakeholders in remote, distributed environments
  • Experience mentoring engineers and raising the technical bar on a team
  • Experience with C++, Typescript/JavaScript, NodeJS, and SQL


#LI-JB1
#LI-Remote

The salary for this role is dependent on geographic location and will be based on the individual candidate's job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

In addition to base salary, for sales and some sales-adjacent roles, employees are eligible to earn incentive compensation (commission). For all other roles, employees are eligible to participate in the Cribl Corporate Bonus Program.

In addition to a competitive salary, Cribl also offers a generous benefits package which includes health, dental, vision, short-term disability, and life insurance, paid holidays and paid time off, a fertility treatment benefit, 401(k), and equity.

Base Salary Range
$205,000—$240,000 USD

Bring Your Whole Self

Diversity drives innovation, enables better decisions to support our customers, and inspires change for the better. We’re building a culture where differences are valued and welcomed, and we work together to bring out the best in each other. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying.

Interested in joining the Cribl herd? Learn more about the smartest, funniest, most passionate goats you’ll ever meet at cribl.io/about-us.
